products.name: RNA 9000 Purity & Integrity kit
products.short_description: The SCIEX RNA 9000 purity and integrity analysis kit provides all the necessary reagents to assess RNA integrity, RNA purity and estimate RNA size. products.name: CZE Rapid charge variant analysis kit
products.short_description: Post translational modifications can occur at every step of the manufacturing process. These modifications can have an effect on a molecules charge states and effect a molecules potency. Identifying these charge variants is required as a regulatory release assay. CZE Capillary Zone Electrophoresis makes charge variant analysis easier then ever before. In under 5 minutes of separation time, the CZE Rapid Charge Variant Analysis Kit can resolve a native state molecules charge variants with little-to-no method development and provide more resolution than icIEF or ion exchange chromatography.

products.name: Micro HPLC Columns
products.short_description: Designed and optimized for SCIEXs microLC systems, our columns operate at high linear flow velocities to ensure optimal performance at faster speeds and higher throughput levels.

products.name: Extraordinary discoveries demand extraordinary proof

products.name: QTRAP 6500+ system

Instantly access qualitative QTRAP scans for identification, characterization and quantification of your samples. Combine sensitive MRM analysis with qualitative insights instantly.

products.name: Learning Hub Success Programs LC-MS and CE training
products.short_description: Get the training your team needs to succeed with SCIEX Now Learning Hub success programs. These series of training courses and resources are designed to upskill your staff to use the latest SCIEX instruments and software.

products.name: X500 QTOF Mass Spectrometer Systems, High Performance Benchtop Instruments
products.short_description: The X500 QTOF systems are your go-to benchtop systems for simplified, high-throughput data acquisition and processing for standardized analyses. The X500B is purpose-built for standard biotherapeutic characterization analyses while the X500R offers robust qualitative and quantitative performance for food, environmental and forensic workflows, or for metabolomic analysis.

products.name: SCIEX Triple QuadTM 4500 LC-MS/MS System
products.short_description: A versatile and powerful quantitative solution. The Triple Quad 4500 system is robust and hardworking, delivering precise data insight day in, day out. It is ideal for labs looking for high performance and versatility in a premium Triple Quad. And when you need it, activate QTRAP functionality and gain simultaneous quantitation and confirmation.

products.name: Don't compromise - obtain high-quality data, at speed.
products.short_description: The Echo MS+ system with Triple Quad 6500+ system combines high-quality data, unparalleled standards of quantitation, and high sample throughput so you can make informed decisions, today. Using contactless sampling via Acoustic Ejection Mass Spectrometry AEMS at sampling rates of up to 1 sample/second, this is a complete solution that removes bottlenecks in high-throughput analytical workflows.

products.name: Fast glycan labeling and analysis kits
products.short_description: The BioPhase Fast Glycan Labeling and Analysis kit provides all of the necessary reagents to release and label N-glycans for analysis on the BioPhase 8800 system with UV/LIF. Designed for the analysis of 200 samples, this kit provides the flexibility and compatibility to achieve high-resolution N-glycan separations for glycan characterization of biotherapeutics.

products.name: OptiFlow Turbo V ion source
